from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to the cause mapping task."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 X》'")
    cause: str = Field(description="The legal cause (案由) identified from the document content that matches the provided task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
